title: Patriotic Anthem of Khasi Land (Ri Khasi, Ri Khasi)
khasi_title: Ri Khasi, Ri Khasi, Nga Ieid Ia Pha
composer: Rev. Dr. John Roberts / D.S. Khongdup
cultural_context: The venerated national and patriotic anthem of the Khasi people. Traditionally sung at community gatherings, Dorbar assemblies, school commencements, and national celebrations. It honors the ancient ancestors, the misty hills, the crystal mountain springs that never run dry even in winter, and the shared quest to drink deeply from the fountain of wisdom (umpohliew jingstad).
lyrics_khasi:
Ri Khasi, Ri Khasi, nga ieid ïa pha,
Ka Ri kaba ieid uba rim uba jah;
Ki tymmen mynhyndai la ngam ïohi shuh,
Jingkynmaw ïa ki kan ym duh.

Lum Khasi, Lum Khasi, kat phi ym ju don,
Ka lyer ba sngewtynnad ngi bam katba mon;
Ka um kaba shngiam ka tuid ha ki wah,
Kam rngad myntlang ruh ka sah.

Lang:—
Ri, Ri, nga ieit thoin thoin la ka ri!
Ngin kiew sha khlieh, sha phrang ngin mih,
Umpohliew jingstad ngin ïadih!

Ki lum ba pyngngad, ki them ba jyrngam,
Ha tnum jong ki ngi ieng da ka nam;
Ka Hok bad ka Sot ngin kdup ha ka shadem,
Ha pyrthei baroh ka nam kan heh kmen!

Shaphrang ngin kiew raieh raidain,
Sha tlong ba mih ki umpohliew,
Jingstad ngin dih ha kliar sangaria,
Ko Meirilung, ki khun ki ksiew!
lyrics_english:
Ri Khasi, Ri Khasi, I love thee dearly,
Beloved homeland of our ancient ancestors who have gone before;
Though our eyes behold no longer the elders of old,
The living memory of them shall never fade away.

O Khasi Mountains, Khasi Hills, none can compare with thee,
The sweet bracing mountain breeze we breathe as freely as we desire;
The crystal pure water flows sweetly down the rocky streams,
It never dries up, remaining cool even through winter's chill.

Chorus:—
Homeland, O Homeland, with tender deepest devotion I love my native land!
We shall climb to the summit, forward we shall march,
From the deep fountain of wisdom we all shall drink!

Cool highlands of peace, emerald green valleys below,
Upon thy sacred soil we stand with honored renown;
Righteousness and Truth we embrace within our breasts,
Across the entire world our fame shall echo in joy!

Forward we shall advance, shoulder to shoulder,
Unto the sacred source where eternal fountains spring,
Wisdom we shall drink upon the highest summits,
O Mother Land, for all thy children and descendants!

stanzas.title: Ka Ri Ki Tymmen (Homeland of the Elders)
stanzas.khasi:
Ri Khasi, Ri Khasi, nga ieid ïa pha,
Ka Ri kaba ieid uba rim uba jah;
Ki tymmen mynhyndai la ngam ïohi shuh,
Jingkynmaw ïa ki kan ym duh.
stanzas.english: Ri Khasi, Ri Khasi, I love thee! Beloved land of our ancient elders; though we see them no more, their sacred memory shall never die.

stanzas.title: Ki Lum bad ki Wah (Hills and Streams)
stanzas.khasi:
Lum Khasi, Lum Khasi, kat phi ym ju don,
Ka lyer ba sngewtynnad ngi bam katba mon;
Ka um kaba shngiam ka tuid ha ki wah,
Kam rngad myntlang ruh ka sah.
stanzas.english: Khasi hills, nothing on earth compares with you! We breathe your sweet air freely; sweet mountain water flows in streams, never running dry even in winter.

stanzas.title: Ka Sur Lang (Chorus of Unity)
stanzas.khasi:
Ri, Ri, nga ieit thoin thoin la ka ri!
Ngin kiew sha khlieh, sha phrang ngin mih,
Umpohliew jingstad ngin ïadih!
stanzas.english: Homeland, Homeland, with pure tender love I cherish thee! We shall climb to the heights, march forward, and drink from the fountain of wisdom!

stanzas.title: Ka Hok bad ka Nam (Righteousness and Renown)
stanzas.khasi:
Ki lum ba pyngngad, ki them ba jyrngam,
Ha tnum jong ki ngi ieng da ka nam;
Ka Hok bad ka Sot ngin kdup ha ka shadem,
Ha pyrthei baroh ka nam kan heh kmen!
stanzas.english: Cool mountains, verdant valleys, on your ridges we stand in honor; holding Righteousness and Truth close to our hearts, our renown shines through all the earth!

stanzas.title: Meirilung (Descendants of the Motherland)
stanzas.khasi:
Shaphrang ngin kiew raieh raidain,
Sha tlong ba mih ki umpohliew,
Jingstad ngin dih ha kliar sangaria,
Ko Meirilung, ki khun ki ksiew!
stanzas.english: Forward we march arm in arm, to the sacred spring whence waters flow, drinking wisdom on high crags, O Mother Earth, for every child and grandchild!

vocabulary.umpohliew: Living natural spring flowing perpetually from highland rock aquifers
vocabulary.shngiam: Sweet, refreshing, delicious to the palate (especially of mountain water)
vocabulary.rngad: To dry up, run dry, evaporate into drought
vocabulary.raieh-raidain: Side-by-side, linked arm-in-arm in united communal harmony
vocabulary.kliar: The very pinnacle, crest, or summit of a highland peak
vocabulary.sangaria: High rocky precipice overlooking deep forested canyons
vocabulary.meirilung: Mother Land; the sacred maternal soil that nourishes the matrilineal clans
